# Yapchik Juice — comic site

A prerendered static site for the comics, hosted on Cloudflare Pages at
`yapchikjuice.com`. The home page shows the latest strip; navigation is
XKCD-style (first / previous / random / next / last) with arrow-key support.

Every strip has its own permanent URL (`/c/<number>/`), its own title,
description, Open Graph image, and structured data, so search engines and
link previews see real HTML rather than JavaScript-rendered content.

## Source files vs. generated files

**Edit these:**

- `comics.js` — **the manifest**: the single source of truth for strips
- `tools/template.html` — HTML template used for every strip page
- `tools/build.js` — the generator
- `tools/analytics.html` — optional analytics snippet (create it when needed)
- `styles.css` — design tokens from the project `DESIGN.md`
- `comics/` — finished, fully composited strip images
- `assets/mark.png` — the Yapchik Juice mark used as masthead and favicon

**Generated by `node tools/build.js` — don't edit by hand:**

- `index.html` — home page (the latest strip, canonical `/`)
- `c/<number>/index.html` — one page per strip
- `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, `404.html`

## Publish a new strip

1. Copy the finished image (mark, sponsor band, signature, and copyright
   already composited onto the art) into `comics/`.
2. Append an entry to `COMICS` in `comics.js` with the next `number`, a unique
   `slug`, the exact article title, the beehiiv date in `YYYY-MM-DD`, the image
   path, its pixel `width`/`height`, and a short `alt` description.
3. Run `node tools/build.js` to regenerate the static pages.
4. Commit and push. Cloudflare publishes the new files automatically.

`number` controls order and the permanent URL; `date` is for display, sitemap
`lastmod`, and structured data. The highest number becomes the home page.

## SEO notes

- Per-page `<title>`, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph/Twitter tags,
  `article:published_time`, and JSON-LD (`WebSite`, `WebPage`, `ComicStory`).
- `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt` are generated from the manifest.
- Old `?n=` links are redirected in `app.js` to the canonical `/c/<number>/` URL.
- `404.html` returns a real 404 (there is no SPA catch-all rewrite).

## Analytics

Create `tools/analytics.html` containing the PostHog snippet, then run
`node tools/build.js` and commit. The generator injects it into the `<head>`
of every generated page. Leave the file absent/empty to disable analytics.

## Newsletter signup

The beehiiv form is embedded in `tools/template.html`. Its loader script sits
inside a native `<dialog>` that opens only when the Subscribe button in the
masthead is clicked; `app.js` handles open/close (Escape and backdrop click
work too). The attribution script sits just before `</body>`. Run
`node tools/build.js` to regenerate the pages after editing. The dialog styling
lives in `styles.css` under "Newsletter signup dialog"; the form's own
appearance is configured in beehiiv's form builder.

## Deploy

Git-backed Cloudflare Pages project connected to this repository:

- Build command: none (generated files are committed)
- Build output directory: `/`
- Custom domain: `yapchikjuice.com` (plus `www`)
